submittedParameters.prompt:
Paint ONE independent new EAST/right-facing running animation frame E02 of 16, full-body single celestial musician girl on transparent RGBA, native 1254x1254 square or larger. No grid or multiple poses.
Image 1 gives ONLY character identity, scale and camera (previous E01); DO NOT COPY ITS LIMB/ARM POSE. Image 2 is original side identity, image 3 same-girl detail, image 4 approved PRIMARY hand-painted style. Keep exactly her face, long plum hair/lotus bun/pearl-gold ornaments, ivory-lavender-gold short tunic and wide sleeves, lavender pants, boots, jade waist knot, violet gold elongated crescent qin. Preserve clean bright rounded Daoist chibi painting and exact existing proportions, with no magenta outline.
Keep fixed camera, head/body size, common canvas and virtual floor y=93.5%. Do not fit by bounding box. Only natural phase motion changes position. Face screen RIGHT; no turn toward viewer. The first frame is a right-leg contact, but YOUR frame is the specific different anatomical action below. Different pose must be immediately visible at 160px size.
POSE E02, 30ms: RIGHT NEAR foot takes weight below front half of pelvis; right knee bends deeply to absorb impact. FAR LEFT heel folds toward buttock and begins recovery, not a trailing straight leg. Both knees appear closer together than E01. Head, chest and carried qin sink 2% canvas. Both elbows flex and lower clearly with compression; qin near end drops with wrist about 3% canvas. Floor fixed. Right ankle contacts floor.
While running, this large instrument is CARRIED, not played: LEFT hand stays on upper/far end, RIGHT hand supports near/lower body. Redraw both articulated shoulder/elbow/wrist chains to suit the described counter-rotation. Qin moves rigidly with both grip points; never detach fingers, swap hands, bend qin, add straps or release hands. Never freeze the arms in the E01 position. Two legs total, no ghost limbs. Keep stable full-body size, no stretching, no image interpolation, no mirrored substitution. Hair/ribbons follow the pose with modest secondary motion; no blur, scenery, floor drawing, cast shadow, text or borders.
